name: SearchSwarm-30B-A3B

lineage.how_derived: SFT on data synthesized by a delegation harness (main agent dispatches bounded subtasks to subagents)

purpose: Foundation action model for long-horizon deep research that internalizes 'delegation intelligence': a main agent decomposes tasks, dispatches bounded subtasks to subagents that work in independent contexts and return compact reports, so the main context budget is not overwhelmed (arXiv 2606.09730).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: SearchSwarm repo LICENSE read (MIT License, 'Copyright (c) 2026 SearchSwarm Authors', summarizer); the base Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B-A3B is Apache-2.0 (text read), so the MIT relicense of a derivative is compatible with the base terms.

architecture.why_this_design: No architecture change; the paper's design argument is behavioural: subagents act as an active context-management mechanism so a finite context budget suffices for long research tasks, and a specialized harness synthesizes the SFT data that teaches when and what to delegate.

pc-12gb.variant: needs a community Q4 (about 18 GB, estimate)

other: vLLM (harness local mode, one server per GPU, ports 6001-6008 via deploy_model.sh)
any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (harness API mode, API_BASE_URL)
engine_support.notes: No GGUF exists (HF search 2026-11-19: single repo, 30.53B BF16 parameters). The weights share the qwen3_moe architecture of Tongyi DeepResearch, which has many community GGUFs, so conversion should be routine but is untested by us. Tool requirements (repo README, summarizer; harness/README.md was not readable): the harness is configured by SEARCH_MODE, TOOL_TYPE and ENABLE_SUB_AGENT (with subagent budgets and an LLM-as-judge setting), takes an API_KEY in harness/.env, and the README credits Serper and Jina as search and page-reading infrastructure; the exact tool names, keys and context window are not on the README. The paper says weights, harness and training data are released.

strengths: Highest self-reported BrowseComp among 30B-A3B research agents on the cards read (68.1)
Context-management by delegation suits small context budgets
weaknesses: Needs a multi-agent harness with search and fetch tools (Serper, Jina named in acknowledgements)
No quantized releases from the authors
soft.maturity: Paper arXiv 2606.09730 (2026-06-08); four finetunes listed; very young.

tona_fit.reason: Best self-reported BrowseComp (68.1) and BrowseComp-ZH (73.3) among 30B-A3B research agents, MIT (text read), same architecture and size as Tongyi DeepResearch so the hardware fit is identical; caveats are unreproduced vendor numbers, 33 downloads, and that the subagent harness is part of the product. Missing GGUF and harness are only blockers.
blockers: subagent harness with search and page-read tools

sources.note: HF search 2026-11-19: only the original repo (33 downloads, 5 likes); no quantized or GGUF child
